note: Hand-written stand-in for a model response so the demo runs without an API key. Re-record with --llm record.

output.explanation: Create order went out without a PayPal-Request-Id, so if the response was lost and the call retried, PayPal would treat it as a new order. Each checkout attempt now sends a fresh UUID as PayPal-Request-Id, which PayPal uses to return the original order for a retried request.
